title: [Aeronautics] Overworld End Sea
description: Enables Create Simulated/Aeronautics' End Sea mechanic in the overworld, for void-accessible worldgen
body:
This simple datapack by default enables the End Sea mechanic from [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) to be present in the overworld at y level -56 and below, saving any lost craft from falling into the void.

**Intended for use with alternate worldgen that leaves the void accessible, i.e. [Exosphere](https://modrinth.com/datapack/exosphere-worldgen)**

![A simple Simulated grid suspended in the End Sea, in the overworld.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce03e56a96ffe8c2498b5c865a4d439d2d7a92d7_0.webp)

Thanks to Aeronautics' generous data formats it's also dead simple to change the affected dimension or add more at will! Just open up the zip, add a .json for your preferred dimension(s) in `data/simulated/end_sea`, and follow the example of the existing overworld.json to customize at your discretion.
